clauses.title: Maximum eccentricity and ovality
clauses.text: 2.1 Maximum eccentricity and ovality of the centre of the nail head from axis of shank shall be 14 percent of shank diameter, Max. Note 1— For tolerance, refer to Table 1 of the standard. Note 2— Length of tapered portion (pointed at bottom) of the nail shall be 1 to 1.5 times the diameter of shank.

clauses.title: Designation – Shall be
clauses.text: 3. Designation - Shall be designated by size, length and the number of the standard. Example- Wall nail

clauses.title: × 30 — IS  6733
clauses.text: 4 × 30 — IS  6733 Roofing nail    5.6 × 50 — IS  6733 4. General Requirements - Nails shall be machine made and may have die marks and feeding knife marks on shank. They shall be uniformly circular in section, straight, free from wastes. Wall nails shall have sharp points and roofing nails, a chiesel point. The heads shall be properly formed and concentric with shanks.

clauses.title: Bend Test – Nails
clauses.text: 6.1 Bend Test -  Nails when cold shall not break or crack when doubled over either by pressure or by blows from a hammer until the internal radius is equal to the diameter of the test piece For  detailed  information, refer to IS 6733 : 1972 Specification for wall and roofing nails. SUMMARY OF IS 6733 : 1972 WALL AND ROOFING NAILS
